title: tests/fixtures/abi-v1/cases.json, format 1
description: The committed, generated (scripts/abi-v1/emit/cases.py) conformance cases every enrolled binding's v1-abi-conformance leg runs against the stub libraries scripts/abi-v1/build-stubs.sh builds. See that emitter's module docstring for the four case kinds (handshake, echo, status, loader) and the three argument-expression shapes (int, bytes_hex, handle). This schema is checked by scripts/abi-v1/parity.py before it trusts the file, using the same restricted JSON Schema subset spec/abi-v1/abi.json's own schema uses (scripts/abi-v1/model.py's validate()); it is not part of gen.py's abi.json/sdk.json pipeline.

os.description: Present only on a loader case whose expected reason differs by platform (ctor-marker: D3's glibc floor step is Linux-only, so the same library is refused on Linux but accepted on darwin). Absent means the case applies on every platform. A conformance runner must OMIT from its report (never fail, never report a pass for) a case whose os does not match its own platform; the parity gate expects, per leg, only the cases whose os is absent or matches that leg (linux = linux-*, darwin = darwin-*).
